action: If you use Bitly links in old posts, emails, ads or print, spot-check that they still lead to the right pages and replace any that do not. Watch Bitly's own notices.
exec: Short links in old posts, emails or print can be repointed after they go inactive; organisations relying on them should check where they lead.
plain: Old Bitly short links in years-old X posts by public figures and companies were redirected to unrelated pages. Bitly says bad actors reused old, inactive links and it is disabling them.
summary: CNN, via KSL, reports that over the weekend some old Bitly short links in X posts from 2009 to 2014, by politicians, agencies and companies, were redirected to unrelated content. Bitly said on X it identified an issue that let bad actors repurpose old, inactive links, suspended the accounts involved and is disabling the affected URLs. The cause and the scale are not stated.
title: Bitly short links hijacked

validation.note: KSL (CNN) read; the tracker entry restates it, so one underlying report plus Bitly's statement as quoted by CNN.
